title: docs(skills): objectstack-ui and objectstack-i18n teach `pressed`, the five `{{ }}` copy slots, `submitText`, the thank-you keys, `kanban.lanes` and report `seriesBy`
body:
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoX9GDX2cb55BEVTSE1eYheJ)_ Fixes #28243 Fixes #28464 Fixes #28190 Fixes #28215 Fixes #28212 Fixes #28207 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none domain:skills#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibz4G9FrLR4TRExx6gn ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:两个对外发布的技能包补教六个平台已经在画的键——动作的 `pressed`(本人已操作的切换态)、动作文案五个 `{{ }}` 槽位(`description`、参数 `helpText`、`outcomeMessages`)、参数对话框按钮文字 `submitText` 及其翻译槽位、表单感谢页的翻译键、看板 `kanban.lanes`、报表图表 `seriesBy`;附一条 `submitText` 的 eval。 - 为什么改:这些键在 spec 和控制台都已落地,但技能文本没教,AI 作者照技能写出的元数据要么用了 `${…}` 被 `os validate` 拒收,要么绕路(用 `matrix` 代替 `seriesBy`,用过滤器想去掉空泳道),要么根本不知道可以改按钮文字、做切换态。 - 风险与回滚:纯文档,不改 schema、键或行为;三个零余量文件的新增全部以同文件删减支付,token 天花板一行不动。回滚 = 撤这个 PR。 - 先看:`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`(六条 bullet 和 `ctx` 一节的压缩是风险 hunk);`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` 的报表示例与 `seriesBy` 注;`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 的 `_views` / `_actions` 两行。 - 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期四个被改文件全绿且 headroom 为 4 / 21 / 2 / 687;`git grep -n 'seriesBy\|lanes:\|submitText\|pressed' skills/objectstack-ui skills/objectstack-i18n` 每个键至少一处命中。 - 需要你做的:受管面(`skills/**`,Tier H)——席位做 Fable 契约复审并写席位核对后,由 os-zhuang 审批落地;dev 不翻 ready、不请求审阅。 ## What changes Six teaching edits, one commit per card (plus a one-line fix-up that swaps a reserved word out of an example), in the files the fold order names. Nothing under `skills/*/references/_index.md`. | Card | Where | What the skill now says | Read against (`main` 82b29fe5) | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | #28243 | `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, a bullet under *Visibility, Disable & Feedback* | `pressed` is a CEL predicate over the same scope as `visible`; while TRUE the record header draws the button pressed (`aria-pressed`); display only, never a gate; a boolean literal is refused; `active` / `activeWhen` / `pressedWhen` rename onto it; a per-reader fact is a block declared under `attachedOnRead`, filled per caller, read as `has(record.viewer) && record.viewer.vote == 'helpful'` | `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:1659-1683` (docblock + describe), `:1013` (renames); `packages/spec/src/ui/action-pressed.test.ts:60` (boolean refused); `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:2441-2470`, `:3201` (`attachedOnRead`); renderer `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:2414-2428`, `:2468` (`page:header`) | | #28464 | same file, the "Copy holes are `{{ }}`" bullet | `confirmText`, `description` and a param's `helpText` read `record`; `successMessage` and each `outcomeMessages` entry read `result` and `record`; `errorMessage` takes none; one example per new slot; `${record.name}`, `{name}`, logic in a hole and a blank sentence fail `os validate` in all of them | `packages/spec/src/ui/action-copy-template.ts:19-45` (roots per key), `:56-70` (the doors refuse), `:143-145` (the reference examples); `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:179-182`, `:396`, `:1117`, `:1532` | | #28190 | same file (`confirmText` and `submitText` bullets, `ReassignLeadAction` example); `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` (eval 11); `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` (`_actions` row) | `submitText` is the verb on the param dialog's submit button in place of "Confirm", an I18nLabel, refused blank and refused without a non-empty `params`; `submitLabel` / `confirmLabel` rename onto it; `confirmText` is the param-less action's confirm dialog, refused beside `params`; translation slot `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.submitText` | `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:936-969` (docblock, blank refusal), `:1010` (renames), `:1436` (describe), `:2248-2257` (`confirmText` beside `params`), `:2269` (`submitText` without `params`); `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts:220-223`, `:513`, `:1042`; renderer `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx:345-364`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.submitText-28158.test.tsx:10-11` | | #28215 | `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, the `_views.{view_name}` row | `submitBehavior.title` / `submitBehavior.message` translate the thank-you panel of a form whose `submitBehavior` is `kind: 'thank-you'`; only authored copy is translated; the other kinds carry none | `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts:271-297` (the shape), `:335`, `:386-402` (the `_views` member); renderer `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:637`, `:1328-1329` | | #28212 | `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`, the kanban example and the note under it | `lanes` lists the stored option values to draw, in that order; a choice of lanes, not a record filter (an unlisted value lands in `Uncategorized`; filter the view to keep records off the board); omit it for one lane per option; a non-option or repeated value fails `os validate` | `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:2320-2365` (`KanbanConfigSchema.lanes`); `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts:370-392`, `:1083-1140` (the two refusals); renderer `ui/packages/core/src/utils/kanban-declared-lanes.ts:10-40` | | #28207 | `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`, the report example and the note under it | `seriesBy` splits the one `yAxis` measure into a series per value of a second dataset dimension, not a `matrix` workaround; it must name a declared dimension other than `xAxis` (publish refuses an unknown name); refused on `pie` / `donut` / `funnel` / `treemap` / `sankey`; with it, `series[].name` names one of its values | `packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts:33-57` (key + describe), `:147-203` (`checkReportChartSeriesSplit`, the two arms from PR #28439); `packages/lint/src/validate-chart-bindings.ts:589-604` (undeclared dimension); renderer `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx:1375-1395` | **Premise re-checked before each commit:** `git grep` on `main` 82b29fe5 finds none of `pressed`, `seriesBy`, `lanes` (kanban), `submitText` (action), `description` / `helpText` / `outcomeMessages` as `{{ }}` slots, or `submitBehavior.title` under `skills/` — the only prior mentions are the generated `references/react-blocks.md` rows for the `object-form` block and the `_actions` row's `outcomeMessages.{outcome}` translation key. Every member's `Blocked-by:` is closed (#28242 / PR #28301, PR #28463, PR #28188 + #28158, PR #28195, #28211 / PR #28291, #28206 / PR #28305). No member dropped. ### Token ratchet — paid by deletion in the same file `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prices every `rules/**` file (convention `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`, the SKILL.md stamp line excluded). The three files this fold grows sat at 1 / 0 / 3 tokens of headroom, so each addition is paid inside its file; the eval fixture is measured, not ratcheted (ruling record 6513306068). No ceiling row moves. | File | Tokens before → after (ceiling) | Lines before → after | Deletions that pay, and where the dropped text still lives | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` | 2258 → 2255 (2259) | 204 → 179 | ① the bare-CEL paragraph under the bullet list folds into the `visible` bullet (same rule, one place); ② the `ctx` section drops its blessed-name code block and the restated hook axes — `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md:362-363`, `:588-608` carry them — and keeps the trusted-execution and ADR-0095 `positions` rules in one paragraph; ③ the `openIn` / `opensInNewTab` prose, the "two mechanisms" lead-in, the new-tab-via-`params` warning and the field-backed-params paragraph are condensed (every rule kept: static vs computed URL, pre-open, `newTabUrl` shape and refusal, own-auth endpoint, the checkbox mis-render, `objectOverride`, `defaultFromRow`); ④ two "Always"/"Best practice" lead-ins trimmed | | `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` | 3129 → 3108 (3129) | 311 → 309 | the "Key rule" blockquote (groupByField is a select, one column per option) folds into the example's own comment and the new `lanes` note; the ADR-0047 bullets "toggle is deprecated" and "the switcher renders as a compact dropdown … a single-entry whitelist locks the visualization" fold into the two code comments that already name `element` and `allowedVisualizations` | | `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` | 6259 → 6260 (6262) | 464 → 463 | the "Engine support" bullet (per-driver bucket functions: `to_char`, `date_format`, `strftime`, `$dateToString`, `bucketDateKey`) and the "Studio's Dashboard Widget Inspector …" bullet — both describe the engine and the Studio, not anything an author writes; the bucket-label table above keeps the author-facing fact | | `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` | 5571 → 5646 (6333) | 524 → 524 | none needed (687 headroom) | | `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` | 2108 → 2320 (not ratcheted) | 105 → 115 | eval 11 added | Whole package: every `skills/*/SKILL.md` summed, 4607 → 4607 lines, 226235 → 226537 bytes; the gate's bundle total (all shipped files, its own convention) 219828 → 220092 tokens (the before figure is the after figure minus the five per-file deltas above; the gate prints the after figure). ## Tests - `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — exit 0: *56 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings*; the four changed authored files read headroom 4 / 21 / 2 / 687. - `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` stays valid JSON (parsed after the edit); eval 11 asks for a param dialog whose button reads the verb and asserts `submitText: 'Log Call'` beside `params`, refusing `submitLabel` / `confirmLabel` / `confirmText`. - The two `os:check` blocks this PR edits (`ReassignLeadAction` gains `submitText`; the report example gains `seriesBy`) compile under `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` — see Verification. - No ablation: a docs-only diff changes no tested behaviour. ## Acceptance notes - **`skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json` unchanged.** The order allowed an i18n eval "if the gate asks"; no derived gate asks for one, and the two new slots are table rows, so none was added. Noted, not filed. - **The `description` copy-hole example reads "owner", not "role".** The first spelling (*Choose the new role for …*, the spec's own reference example) tripped `check:role-word` (ADR-0090 D3 ratchets the word in published prose), so the example names the owner instead; the fix-up is its own commit because the branch is shared under AGENTS.md §3 and was not rewritten. - **`pressed` scope.** The card says "`record` and `user`"; the schema docblock says "the same scope as `visible` and `disabled`", and `visible`'s own describe names `record` + `current_user`, so the rule says "the same scope as `visible`" rather than naming a root the card spelled differently. - **`confirmText` beside `params` is refused** (`action.zod.ts:2248`) — a fact one step outside the six cards, carried into the `confirmText` bullet because it is the contrast #28190 asks for ("It is not `confirmText`"). Two words, no new scope. - **The deleted `ctx` code block** was the one place in `skills/` that spelled `ctx.user?.organizationId ?? ctx.session?.organizationId` as a fenced line; the expression now stands inline in the same paragraph, and `data-hooks.md` keeps the fenced form. - Out-of-scope findings: none. ## Verification All readings at head `162680ed` (worktree `/home/user/objectstack-28243`, base `origin/main` 82b29fe5).
